extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the question: 1) Category labels had misspellings and case variants (e.g., 'Office Suplies', 'Furnture', 'Accesories') which were normalized into the allowed labels. 2) Price was stored as text with a dollar sign ('$50.00') and was successfully converted to a number. 3) Three rows had negative Quantity values (-5, -3, -7), which violate the rule that Quantity must be at least 1; these were excluded. After fixes, the analysis shows 20 orders in Accessories, 12 in Electronics, 9 in Furniture, and 15 in Office Supplies.
